{{Quote|We do not fight out of natural aggression, but out of a deep-seated sense of self-preservation. Remove the cause of conflict, and the hostilities will cease.|Ceenda Bekkar|<ref name="J7 Galaxy Newsnet" />}}
The '''CSA-Trianii War''' was a major border war between the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] and the [[Trianii]], that started in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] and went on for at least another three years, until [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].

==Prelude==
The [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] (CSA) claimed a chain of systems as property ceded to it in its corporate charter with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Those systems were previously owned by the [[Trianii/Legends|Trianii]] settlers.<ref name="J7 Galaxy Newsnet" />

==The war==
The CSA-Trianii War happened along the chain of systems claimed by the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]]. The CSA suspected that the [[Trianii/Legends|Trianii]] colonies intended to make the taking of their land more trouble than it was worth. An armistice was then decided on after seven months of delicate negotiations on both sides of the conflict. [[Halbreck Dodd]] was one of the negotiators of the CSA, and [[Ceenda Bekkar]] was a chief negotiator of the Trianii.<ref name="J7 Galaxy Newsnet" />
